description:
250W motor & 36V battery

the electric bicycle for adults is equipped with a 250W stable rear hub motor, the top speed is up to 25 km/h;

comes with a 36V lithium-ion battery, which is removable, the range is up to 20-25 miles in electric mode.

SHIMANO 7-SPEED

The electric mountain bike has a 7 speed transmission system that meets your speed needs for uphill, downhill, acceleration and deceleration.

Suspension Fork & Mechanical Disc Brake

This e-bike adopts the lock-out suspension fork, which allows you to ride on flat roads with less effort, while giving you more safety on rough mountain roads;

The perfect front and rear disc brake fully protect your safety; both can effectively ensure your safety.

Special features

there are 5 levels of support on the LCD display; the electric mountain bike has a complete lighting system with light and reflectors.

Professional service

The Hiland electric bike is suitable for people with a height of 155 cm - 178 cm. This E-MTB is 85% pre-assembled,

but don't worry about installation, we provide instructions and tool kit, even if you have any other questions, you can contact us directly.

About Hiland

HILAND had a simple yet powerful mission — to bring the joy of cycling and a healthy, positive lifestyle to everyone. From the very beginning, HILAND set out to provide affordable, high-quality bicycles that would make the freedom of riding accessible to all.

We've got our own manufacturing facilities, so we ensure that each bike we make brings top-notch performance and affordability to our amazing customers.

【Conquer all road conditions with ease】
Monarch 1.0 is an electric mountain bike of Hiland with countless favorable reviews. It is an eye-catching bike featuring a combination of comfort, utility and performance. Its professional configurations make it the first choice for commuting, exercising or hiking with friends, and it can deliver strong power even when riding into a headwind. Ride a Monarch and it will take you wherever you want to go!
